The '''Pesitiin system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located on the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Pesitiin]].
